kind_why: A combat surf map: built to fight on rather than to time (see notes). 'arena' keeps it out of g2gfast's rotation, vote and nominations -- it stays installed, loadable with `map`, and listed on M as combat -- and marks it for game-arena's deathmatch.
author: Sangre Nueva

attribution.author: Sangre Nueva
attribution.source: https://gamebanana.com/mods/123157 (Key Authors: Sangre Nueva (levels 1-4, jail, system), Nikki (bonus level, spawn), T-R-O-N (skybox), LodyBlokady (glass textures); submitter Sangre Nueva)

notes: Credit only, and deliberately no zones: a race round with an end jail. 35 team spawns a side, 10 game_player_equip, gun buttons per level (gun_lvl1..gun_lvlbonus), glass that breaks when the first player through reaches each level, an Endround_tele and a knife-fight end jail with saw blades and rockets. Its 114 trigger_teleports are level spawns enabled and disabled by that system (spawn_lvl3, spawn4 behind cheat_protection, lvl2_spawn behind bonus_entry_denied). gb-maps-2. Not published.

round_teleports.note: `Endround_tele` is enabled at the round's end and `afktele` by the AFK timer; both are boxes round the spawn rows; until then each starts disabled. This game runs no round, so imported they were pits round the spawn that sent a player who walked out and back in to the spawn (headless_imported: 'never touches a pit on the way down', 2026-10-11). Dropped, as the map is at the start of a round
